papers.abstract: We present a systematic measurement study of seven tactics for reducing cloud LLM token usage when a small local model can act as a triage layer in front of a frontier cloud model. papers.title: Optimising Blockchain Scalability for Real-Time IoT Applications
papers.abstract: The convergence of blockchain and the Internet of Things (IoT) enables secure, decentralised, and verifiable data exchange across distributed smart environments. However, traditional blockchain frameworks suffer from inherent scalability constraints, limited throughput, and high latency, which conflict with the stringent real-time requirements of IoT applications such as industrial automation, intelligent healthcare, and smart transportation.
